name: Ultron

abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Absorption
Attacks that deal Energy Damage cause Ultron to Regenerate [20 - 66]% of the damage dealt to him. Each Energy-based attack also grants Ultron a burst of Power based on the damage dealt.
Incoming Incinerate and Shock effects suffer -[25 - 80]% Duration.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Şok süresini %80 azaltır ⚡️⏰
• Yakma süresini %80 azaltır 🔥⏰

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Advanced robotics causes Ultron's Function abilities to have a 100% chance to trigger and to be unaffected by Ability Accuracy. Additionally, Ultron is Immune to Bleed, Poison and Slow effects.
Function (Evade) - Every 7 seconds, Evade incoming Attacks for 1.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: When Health Drops Below 50% and 25%
content: Function (Heal) - Once Per Fight - Gain a Self-Repair Buff healing [36,002.25] Health over 10 seconds. If Stunned while Self Repair is active, Connection is Lost and the Self-Repair is removed.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Function (Critical) - Every 5th attack is a guaranteed Critical Hit.
Function (Damage) - Every 3rd attack inflicts a Bleed Debuff, causing [6,042.6] direct damage over 6 seconds. If the target is Mutant, instead inflict a matching Degeneration Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: Function (Armor) - Every 4th Blocked attack grants an Armor Up Buff, providing +[485.29] Armor Rating for 30 seconds. Well-Timed Blocks count as 4 Blocked attacks for this purpose.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Triggers Function (Damage) for each unique Function Ultron has utilized during the fight. Cooldown: 5 seconds per unique Function utilized during the fight.

abilitySections.title: Launch a Special Attack
content: Function (Cauterize) - Remove all effects from the opponent caused by Ultron's Function (Damage). Gain +[5,035.5] Attack Rating for each effect removed this way for the duration of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Function (Stun) - Inflict a Stun Debuff lasting 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The attack bonus granted by Function (Cauterize) lingers for 10 seconds after this attack is finished.
Any Function (Damage) Debuffs triggered during this attack are doubled.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Function (Stun) - Inflict a Stun Debuff lasting 3.5 seconds.
Function (Burn) - Inflicts Power Burn, draining 2 bar(s) of Power and dealing direct damage proportional to the Power Drained.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Absorption
content: Attacks that deal Energy Damage cause Ultron to Regenerate [20 - 66]% of the damage dealt to him. Each Energy-based attack also grants Ultron a burst of Power based on the damage dealt.
Incoming Incinerate and Shock effects suffer -[25 - 80]% Duration.
